platform: Windows (WebView2 in the e2e build) + a second headless Chrome as the LAN browser

steps.name: connect to the app over CDP
Training mode: 3 simulated devices GOOD in the app
sharing is off at start: no link, no header indicator
interface list offers private addresses only
default port is 8443
link is https://<ip>:8443/?t=<128-bit hex token>
QR code is drawn
the 'Sharing is off' form is not visible while sharing is on
certificate fingerprint is shown (SHA-256)
header shows that the network view is on
the token is in exactly one request: GET / answered 303 to /
the address bar no longer holds the token
location.search and referrer are token-free
server selects the read-only build (meta buslink-mode=lan)
LAN browser shows the 3 devices with GOOD tiles
live stream connected
read-only notice is shown
steps.detail: Read-only view. You can watch live values and trends; nothing can be connected, changed or exported from here.

steps.name: every device card still says 'Simulated device'
tiles carry value, unit, quality and age
the stream and API requests carried no token in their URLs
navigation is overview + trends only
no connect, arm, write or export controls in the DOM
steps.detail: buttons: Pause live updates | Compact tiles

steps.name: session cookie is Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict
browser probes: GET with cookie 200; POST/PUT/DELETE never 2xx; unknown routes 404
no token / wrong token: 401
the right token in the URL is refused on API and asset routes (cookie only)
the app lists the connected viewer
TIMEOUT on the host shows in the browser with the quality badge
communication alarm count is in the browser banner (display only)
the banner is not a link to the alarm list
browser trend shows the gap 'No data: TIMEOUT'
steps.detail: Simulated temperature controller (simulated): Process temperature (PV) — No data: TIMEOUT · 22:18:39–22:18:41 | Simulated temperature controller (simulated): Setpoint (SP) — No data: TIMEOUT · 22:18:39–22:18:41

steps.name: 1 h history comes from GET /api/trend (decimated on the host)
LAN view at 360 px: no horizontal page scroll
Stop sharing closes the browser's stream (it says 'reconnecting')
the port refuses new connections after Stop
the app shows sharing off again and the header indicator is gone
restart issues a new token
the old link answers 401 after the restart
